label: Research-infrastructure site
description: A site registered in DEIMS-SDR by a GERI research infrastructure, with no more specific type

label: LTER site
description: Long-term ecological research site (DEIMS site type: stationary land-based or water-based site)

label: LTSER platform
description: Long-term socio-ecological research platform: a landscape-scale area grouping several sites (DEIMS 'Socio-ecological research platform')

label: NEON terrestrial site
description: NEON terrestrial field site (tower, soil and organismal plots)

label: NEON aquatic site
description: NEON aquatic field site (stream, river or lake)

label: ICOS ecosystem station
description: ICOS ecosystem (ES) station: eddy-covariance flux tower with ancillary ecosystem measurements

label: ICOS atmosphere station
description: ICOS atmosphere (AS) station: greenhouse-gas concentration measurement, often a tall tower

label: ICOS ocean station
description: ICOS ocean (OS) station: ship of opportunity or fixed ocean platform measuring surface-ocean CO2

label: TERN SuperSite
description: TERN SuperSite: intensively instrumented long-term ecosystem observatory

label: Plot network
description: A network of long-term plots registered as one site (e.g. TERN LTERN / AusLTER plot networks)

label: Field station
description: Permanent research station with staff and facilities (e.g. CERN field stations)

label: Flux tower
description: Eddy-covariance flux tower outside ICOS (e.g. OzFlux, SAEON/EFTEON eddy-covariance stations)

label: Marine site
description: Coastal or offshore observation site (e.g. SAEON sentinel sites, climate arrays)
